==Rewards==
{{Main|Reward pool}}

After subduing Tempoross, players will receive reward permits based on their points earned. A permit allows one search of the [[reward pool]] at the Ruins of Unkah using a [[Small fishing net|small]] or [[big fishing net]]; one may be taken from the [[Spirit Angler (Reward pool)|spirit angler]] by the pool with the 'Take-net' option. One reward permit is given for the first 2,000 points scored, with an additional permit awarded for every 700 points beyond 2,000. Excess points count towards a linearly scaling chance for an additional permit.

[[Skill boosts]] '''do not''' affect the rewards received. Rewards are determined based upon the player's base [[Fishing]] level at the time of searching the pool, '''not''' when the permit is received.

Unlike [[Wintertodt]], no additional experience is awarded upon Tempoross' defeat, with all experience gained during the course of the fight.

The debris can contain some unique rewards:
*[[Spirit flakes]] - Provides a 50% chance of catching an extra fish for no additional XP. Stacks with [[Rada's blessing]].
*[[Fish barrel]] - Stores up to 28 raw fish, which can only be removed at a bank. Can be combined with a [[fish sack]] to make it equipable.
*[[Tackle box]] - Stores [[fishing equipment]].
*[[Big harpoonfish]] - Can be mounted in a [[skill hall]].
*[[Tome of water]] - Requires level 50 in [[Magic]] to wield, it is charged with soaked pages. The tome acts as an infinite stock of [[water runes]], increases damage from [[water spell]]s by 10%, and increases accuracy of water, curse, and binding spells by 20%.
*[[Tiny tempor]] - Tempoross [[pet]]. Obtained from fishing in the reward pool, not from killing the boss itself.
*[[Dragon harpoon]]
